title: 第一百零二章 请神第一百零一章 大神通碎片
content_zh:
第一百零二章请神
“这怎么可能！？”
黑袍道人脸上的白粉因惊恐而扑簌簌的往下掉。
“血勾镰”被他饲养多年，从未出过差池。
这东西直接作用于因果之上，只要锁定了对手的魂魄，便能绕过一切防御将其勾出体外。
可眼前这人身后只是浮现出那一轮明月，竟使得“血勾镰”勾魂失去了效果。
“你做了什么？”黑袍道人的声音陡然拔高。
他不明白，这秘境之中，从未失手过的因果杀招，为何会在这外来者身上失效。
苏阎收起玉枢洞玄衍的法诀摇了摇头。
“我还以为你有多强，原来只有这点手段。”
他本以为这秘境中依靠吞噬长生尸走出的修炼法门会有多难缠，结果说到底，不过是借着几分残缺的法则在因果上动些粗浅手脚。
连外面那些筑基真人的推演都比不上，也配拿来对付他？
倒真是高看了这帮人不人鬼不鬼的东西。
不过这样也好，倒是省去了他不少功夫。
话音落下，苏阎没再废话。
右脚蹬地，身形拔起，九转化龙真诀催动之下，体内真气经历九重蜕变，一股莽荒太古的蛮横气息从他体表炸散开来。
苍兕变，太虚龙象拳。
一拳轰出。
拳锋爆开刺目的金光，一只蛮荒巨象的虚影从他拳锋之上践踏而出，带着碾碎万物的重力，朝黑袍道人当头轧下。
黑袍道人见此肝胆俱裂，急忙催动那只黑衣鬼上前抵挡。

只见那长生尸挥舞着血镰，交叉挡在胸前，试图架住那头巨象。
“轰！！”
两股力量相撞，只是一个照面。
黑袍道人那引以为傲的“血勾镰”在象蹄下寸寸崩碎。
长生尸的胸腔直接凹陷下去，连带着后方的黑袍道人一起被砸飞。
“噗！”
黑袍道人人在半空，仰头喷出一大口鲜血，重重砸在后方的残破牌坊上。
他捂着胸口，满眼骇然地盯着苏阎。
这外来者的实力怎么会如此恐怖！
这等威压，这等蛮横的肉身力量，别说是他一个无常，就算是教内那些高高在上的“罗酆天王”，只怕也占不到半点便宜。
自己绝不是他的对手。
这个念头一旦升起，便再压不下去。
content_en:
Chapter 102 Asking God
"How is this possible!?"
The white powder on the black-robed Taoist's face fluttered down out of fear.
He has raised the "Blood Hook Scythe" for many years and has never had any trouble.
This thing directly acts on cause and effect. As long as it locks on the opponent's soul, it can bypass all defenses and draw it out of the body.
But the bright moon appeared behind the man in front of him, which actually made the "Blood Hook Scythe" lose its effect on the soul.
"What did you do?" The black-robed Taoist's voice suddenly rose in pitch.
He didn't understand why the causal killing move that had never failed in this secret realm failed on this outsider.
Su Yan put away Yushudong Xuanyan's magic formula and shook his head.
"I thought you were so strong, but it turns out you only have this ability."
He originally thought that the cultivation method in this secret realm that relies on swallowing immortal corpses would be difficult to deal with. In the end, it turned out that it was just a superficial manipulation of cause and effect through a somewhat incomplete law.
It's not even comparable to the deductions of those outside foundation-building masters, is it worthy of being used against him?
I really have a high opinion of these people who are neither humans nor ghosts.
But this was good, it saved him a lot of effort.
After the words fell, Su Yan stopped talking nonsense.
Pushing his right foot on the ground, he lifted his body up. Under the stimulation of the Nine-Transformation Dragon True Art, the true energy in his body went through nine levels of transformation, and a wild and ancient arrogant aura exploded from his body.
Cang Si changes, Taixu Dragon Elephant Fist.
Punch out.
The edge of his fist exploded with dazzling golden light, and the shadow of a wild giant elephant trampled out from the edge of his fist. With the gravity of crushing everything, it rolled down towards the black-robed Taoist.
Seeing this, the black-robed Taoist was heartbroken and hurriedly urged the black-robed ghost to step forward to resist.
I saw the immortal corpse waving the blood sickle, crossing it in front of the chest, trying to hold the giant elephant.
"Boom!!"
The collision of two forces is just a face-to-face encounter.
The "blood hook sickle" that the black-robed Taoist was proud of was shattered inch by inch under the elephant's hooves.
The chest of the immortal corpse sank directly, and the black-robed Taoist behind him was smashed away.
"Poof!"
The black-robed Taoist was in mid-air, raising his head and spitting out a large mouthful of blood, hitting the broken archway behind him heavily.
He covered his chest and stared at Su Yan in horror.
How could the strength of this outsider be so terrifying!
With such coercion and such arrogant physical power, not to mention his impermanence, even those high-ranking "Luofeng Heavenly Kings" in the sect would not be able to take advantage of him at all.
I am definitely no match for him.
Once this thought arises, it can no longer be suppressed.
